functions.name: Run
functions.summary: Run exercises a [slog.Handler] on the same test cases as [TestHandler], but runs each case in a subtest. For each test case, it first calls newHandler to get an instance of the handler under test, then runs the test case, then calls result to get the result. If the test case fails, it calls t.Error.
